traits.name: Incubus Form
traits.text: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

actions.name: Fiendish Touch
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.text: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Cha- risma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Fail- ure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Failure or Success
actions.text: The target’s Hit Point maximum de- creases by an amount equal to the damage taken. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The succubus shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly

actions.name: Speed is available only in its true form
actions.text: Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. Tarrasque Tarrasque
